# pkgdiff

> Compare and analyze package versions across NuGet, npm, PyPI and Pub registries. Track breaking changes, view detailed release notes, and understand version differences with our free online diff tool.

## Overview

pkgdiff is a web-based tool that helps developers compare package versions across different registries (NuGet, npm, PyPI and Pub). It aggregates release notes from multiple sources including registry pages and GitHub Releases, providing a consolidated view of changes between any two versions. Perfect for developers upgrading dependencies and managing package updates.

## Core Features

- **Multi-Registry Support**: Search packages across NuGet, npm, and other registries
- **Release Notes Aggregation**: Combines release notes from registry pages and GitHub Releases
- **Version Diff**: Compare any two versions to see consolidated changelogs
- **Real-Time Updates**: Background jobs continuously fetch and update package data
- **Categorized Changes**: Release notes are automatically categorized by type (features, fixes, breaking changes, etc.)
- **Export Functionality**: Export release notes in multiple formats (Markdown, JSON, Text)

## Main Pages

### Home (/)
The landing page features a search interface where users can:
- Select a package registry from the dropdown (NuGet, npm, etc.)
- Search for any package by name
- View live updates of recently analyzed packages
- Access example searches with popular packages

### Package Page (/package/:registry/:packageId)
Displays detailed information about a specific package:
- Package metadata (description, authors, license, repository)
- Complete version history with release dates
- Tabbed interface for viewing releases and comparing versions
- Direct links to package registry and source repository
- Categorized release notes for each version

### Browse Packages (/packages)
List view of all packages in the system with:
- Filtering by registry
- Search functionality
- Sorting options
- Pagination

## API Endpoints

The service exposes a REST API:

- `GET /api/package/{registry}/{packageId}` - Get package metadata and versions
- `POST /api/package/analyze` - Trigger package analysis
- `GET /api/package/registries` - List supported registries
- `GET /api/package/recent` - Get recent package searches
- `GET /health` - Service health check

## Data Sources

pkgdiff retrieves data from:
1. **NuGet.org**: For .NET packages
2. **npmjs.com**: For Node.js packages  
3. **GitHub Releases**: Fallback for release notes when registry data is incomplete
4. **Package repositories**: Direct links to source code and issue trackers

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: Angular with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: ASP.NET Core Web API
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Entity Framework Core
- **Real-time Communication**: SignalR for live analysis updates
- **Background Jobs**: Hangfire for scheduled scraping tasks
- **Caching**: 30-day cache for package data

## Search Capabilities

Users can search for:
- Package names (e.g., "Newtonsoft.Json", "react")
- View all versions with release dates
- Compare any two versions
- Filter by registry type
- Access recent and popular searches

## Content Organization

- Release notes are scraped from registry pages and GitHub
- Changes are categorized automatically (New Features, Bug Fixes, Breaking Changes, etc.)
- Version comparisons show consolidated changelogs
- All changes are timestamped and linked to sources

## Privacy & Terms

- Minimal data collection (search history, IP for rate limiting)
- No third-party tracking or advertising
- Open-source project
- Free to use
- See /privacy and /terms for detailed policies

## Use Cases

pkgdiff is designed for developers who need to:
- Understand what changed between package versions
- Review breaking changes before upgrading dependencies
- Analyze release notes from multiple sources in one place
- Export changelogs for documentation
- Track package evolution over time
